name: AP_AWT_TAX_RATES_ALL
description: AP_AWT_TAX_RATES_ALL contains tax rates for Withholding tax type tax codes.  Oracle Payables predefines the Standard and Penalty tax rate types for withholding taxes.  In addition, Certificate rate types are assigned to a specific supplier site and Exception rate types are assigned to a specific invoice.  START_AMOUNT and END_AMOUNT columns are only used if the parent withholding tax uses amount ranges.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax rate identifier

columns.name: TAX_NAME
columns.description: Withholding tax name for which tax rates are defined.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Percentage that is deducted from the amount due to the supplier and paid to the tax authority on behalf of the supplier.

columns.name: RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the category of the withholding tax rates, such as standard or penalty.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date to withhold for this rate

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date to withhold for this rate

columns.name: START_AMOUNT
columns.description: Start amount for given amount range.

columns.name: END_AMOUNT
columns.description: End amount for given amount range.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of supplier if any certificates are defined.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier.  Required when VENDOR_ID is populated

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: Invoice Number.  Oracle Payables stores the invoice number and not the invoice identifier because the invoice may not have been entered at the time of the creation of this record

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Certificate number associated with tax exemption.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_TYPE
columns.description: Certificate type (user-definable)

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Additional details that can be tracked in comments.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Must be entered if two or more certificates cover the same supplier site; must be unique within the date range for the supplier site

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
